data.name: Cicily
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kyzikos', meaning 'native of Kyzikos'. The name Cicily holds a rich meaning, representing abundance, prosperity, and success in various aspects of life. In ancient Greece, the city of Kyzikos was known for its wealth, and the name became a symbol of good fortune and prosperity. In Christian tradition, the name is also associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity.
